name: Turning The Other Cheek
overview: The teaching of "Turning The Other Cheek" contrasts the Old Testament principle of retributive justice, expressed in the law of 'an eye for an eye' (Exodus 21:24; Matthew 5:38), with Christ's call to respond to personal offenses with grace and non-retaliation. Jesus instructs believers not to resist evil through vengeance but to offer the other cheek when struck (Matthew 5:39), emphasizing a higher standard of love and forgiveness. This approach aligns with His broader teaching against violence, as He warns that those who live by the sword will perish by it (Matthew 26:52), inviting followers to embody God's kingdom through mercy rather than retaliation.
